title: Spiritual Fallacy
description: Insisting that something meant to be literal is actually “spiritual” as an explanation or justification for something that otherwise would not fit in an explanation.
logical_form: X makes no sense; therefore, X was meant in a “spiritual” sense.

examples.example: Of course, the Koran is not a history or science book, but each and every story in it does contain a spiritual truth.
examples.explanation: Because we cannot define or prove a “spiritual truth”, anything can be a spiritual truth.

examples.example: Harold Camping, the preacher who predicted the rapture in 2011, said that the rapture actually did come, but it was a "spiritual" rapture.  Of course, there is no way to demonstrate this.
examples.explanation: We can’t use “spiritual” as a get-out-of-jail-free card to cover up an apparent contradiction.

exceptions:
It is not a fallacy when it is specifically referred to as “spiritual”.

“and drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ.” (1 Cor 10:4)
tips: Next time you get pulled over for speeding, tell the cop you were only “spiritually” speeding. See if that works.
references: This is an original logical fallacy named by the author.
description_et: Nõuda, et midagi, mis on mõeldud olema sõnasõnaline, on tegelikult "vaimne" kui selgitus või õigustus millelegi, mis muidu ei sobiks selgitusse.
logical_form_et: X-l pole mõtet; seetõttu mõeldi X-i "vaimses" tähenduses.
exceptions_et:
See ei ole eksitus, kui seda nimetatakse konkreetselt "vaimseks".

"ja jõid sedasama vaimset jooki, sest nad jõid neid saatnud vaimsest kaljust ja see kalju oli Kristus." (1Kr 10:4)
tips_et: Järgmine kord, kui teid kiiruseületamise eest kõrvale tõmmatakse, öelge politseinikule, et ületasite kiirust ainult "vaimselt". Vaadake, kas see töötab.

examples_et.example: Muidugi ei ole Koraan ajaloo- ega teadusraamat, kuid iga selle lugu sisaldab vaimset tõde.
examples_et.explanation: Kuna me ei saa määratleda ega tõestada "vaimset tõde", võib kõik olla vaimne tõde.
examples_et.original_example: Of course, the Koran is not a history or science book, but each and every story in it does contain a spiritual truth.
examples_et.original_explanation: Because we cannot define or prove a “spiritual truth”, anything can be a spiritual truth.

examples_et.example: 2011. aastal ülestõusmist ennustanud jutlustaja Harold Camping ütles, et ülestõusmine tuli tegelikult, kuid see oli "vaimne" ülesvõtmine.  Loomulikult ei saa seda kuidagi demonstreerida.
examples_et.explanation: Me ei saa kasutada "vaimset" kui vanglast vabanemise kaarti, et varjata ilmset vastuolu.
examples_et.original_example: Harold Camping, the preacher who predicted the rapture in 2011, said that the rapture actually did come, but it was a "spiritual" rapture.  Of course, there is no way to demonstrate this.
examples_et.original_explanation: We can’t use “spiritual” as a get-out-of-jail-free card to cover up an apparent contradiction.
